exactOwnerQuotedPrompt:
The camera makes a short orbit at a slow, steady pace around the existing front headlamp toward the frontal centerline over three seconds, revealing slightly more grille and less outer fender. Retain the tight front-half framing without reaching a fully frontal view.
Use @yj_garden_v3 as the same single parked vehicle. Its position, orientation and tire contact patches remain fixed relative to the driveway. Keep camera height, focal length and subject distance steady, with natural scene parallax.
Preserve the original black bumper geometry, seams and bolts. Its vertical front face remains exposed black metal throughout: no license plate, plate holder, dealer plate or rectangular plaque.
The single original “Jeep” word is shallow, raised BLACK-ON-BLACK lettering molded directly into the bumper’s horizontal TOP surface immediately ahead of the grille. It is part of the bumper itself, with no separate backing panel, border or frame. Its visibility follows perspective and natural cropping.
Keep the existing diagonal wipers and all lamps off. Only the camera moves; the vehicle and wheels remain stationary. One continuous shot, no zoom, cuts or fading.
